scope: User-visible content of the complete XING optimalizace pro joby conversation export plus the supplied historical R1-R7 packages and nested evidence archives relevant to the davidanderle.com programme.
explicitExclusions: Tool-internal implementation messages not visible to the user
Unrelated conversations outside the supplied website-programme corpus

integrity.reasonRawBytesNotCommitted: The corpus contains personal conversation history and large nested evidence archives. The public repository stores the reviewed manifest and traceability dispositions rather than republishing the private corpus.

reviewMethod: Parse the complete visible transcript in chronological order.
Recursively inventory supplied historical packages and nested archives.
Identify active authorities, supersessions, prohibitions, acceptance gates and carry-forwards.
Normalize materially distinct requirements while retaining source locators.
Classify duplicate prompt boilerplate and research-method instructions separately from product requirements.
Require every deferred material requirement to bind to an exact R8-R13 gate.
Treat any unresolved material clause as an R7 closure blocker.
limitations: The manifest proves the reviewed corpus boundary and method; it does not republish the source conversation.
A future newly supplied historical artifact outside this corpus would require a new traceability version rather than retroactive silent inclusion.
